title: 第2章 脱胎换骨
content_zh:
石岩站在血池中，池水只到他腰间，可血池内的血水，却仿佛一下子有了生命，竟然凝炼如蔓藤，顺着他身体往上缠绕，只是短短几秒钟，他全身便被血水覆盖，整个人被裹的严严实实。

血池内的血水，仿佛成了一条条猩红的血蛇，还在继续缠绕着他，将他包裹成一个巨大的血茧。

剧痛蔓延全身，石岩脑子像是被绞刀狠狠地剐，痛不欲生。

仿佛有亿万只微小的虫豸，正通过他浑身的毛细孔钻入他身体，在他四肢百骸五脏六腑中蠕动，像在啃噬他身体的血肉，带给如千刀万剐般的痛苦折磨。

石岩目不能视，想要嚎叫，却发不出任何声音，身体也动弹不得。

一丝丝奇异的**，顺着他的筋脉缓缓流动，如涓涓细流，那些**所过之处，他体内从未接触过异力的筋脉如被撕裂，那些**迅猛地流动，分成无数股，疯狂地注入他浑身七百二十个穴道。

石岩觉得自己体内七百二十个穴道，似乎被突然撑大了无数倍，一会儿炙热无比，一会儿变得冰寒彻骨，说不出的难受。

脑海中的刺痛越来越甚，恍恍惚惚间，石岩仿佛看见自己的穴道在那些奇异**的注入下，正发生着诡异的变化，体内每一个穴道似乎都变成了一个个小小的气旋，在疯狂的旋动着。

一丝丝殷红的**，注入了那些气旋之中，似乎被迅速的消化，成了气旋的一部分，而气旋在得到那些**之后，却变得越来越大，变大之后的气旋，消化那些**的速度逐渐加快。

不知道是不是因为痛苦超出了承受能力，石岩在浑浑噩噩的状态下，感觉自己的身体像是成了一具巨大的容器，那些从浑身毛孔涌入体内的奇异**，像是在以一种他无法理解的方式在改变他的身体。

确切的说，它们在改变他身体内存在的七百二十个穴道！

当这个念头在脑海之中浮现之后，下一刻，一股难以承受的刺痛冷不防在他脑海之中轰然爆发，石岩所有的意识荡然无存，瞬间昏厥了过去。

不知道过了多久，石岩再次悠悠醒来。

他马上发现脑海中和身体上的痛苦不在了，体内也不再有那些奇异的**流动，认真去感受去体悟，他除了觉得浑身穴道还隐隐生痛之外，身体一切似乎又恢复了正常。

突然，他感觉到有一股暖暖的气流，小蛇一样在他体内的筋脉中游动着，一个小周天过后，他浑身舒适，手脚似乎都多了几分力量。

石岩心中一跳，马上意识到血池终究带给了他一点好处了，在体内筋脉中小蛇一样游动着，显然是武者才能够拥有的精元！

通过另一个石岩的记忆，他知道精元是这个世界武者的力量之源，也是武者释放强大武技的基础。

按照体内精元的强弱和境界的高低，武者又被严格的划分为十个等级，分别为后天、先天、人位、百劫、地位、涅槃、天位、通神、真神、神王十大境界，每一个境界，又分为三重天。

武者就是这个世界的强者，判断武者和普通人区别的最大的依据，就是看一个人体内有没有精元存在，只要一个人体内拥有一点精元，不论多少，这个人都可以称为武者。

很多人，终其一生也无法拥有精元，一个人只要拥有精元，是可以通过刻苦的修炼令精元壮大的，因此，只要是拥有精元的武者，在这个世界上总有一席之地。

感受着体内那一缕微弱精元的缓缓流动，石岩突然心安了一些，他知道这下子就算是回不去了，他也不至于在这个世界饿死。

放下心来，石岩马上察觉到覆盖了他全身的血茧依旧存在，还是将他裹得严严实实。

血茧破裂成一个大口子，石岩猛地跳出来，望了望四周，他发现自己还在那个奇特的石洞中，周遭白骨累累。

然而，血池之中的血水，竟然干枯了，一滴不剩！

枯竭后的血池中，只剩下几十块碎断的白骨，那猩红浓稠的满池子血水，消失的无影无踪。

一个巨大的血茧，高高耸立在血池中央，血茧薄如蝉翼，还有莹莹光亮，然而，他只是看了一眼，那血茧便从底下燃起了小火苗，火苗由小变大，竟然将血池内的白骨也燃起了，只是一会儿功夫，血池中的血茧和白骨都被烧的干干净净。

干枯的血池中，红光熠熠，一枚有着繁琐血纹的古朴戒指，安静地落在血池中。

盯着那一枚奇异的戒指望了几眼，石岩隐隐觉得这一枚戒指和血池大有关系，犹豫了一下，石岩上前将那一枚戒指捡起来，顺势套在自己左手无名指上。

温热的感觉从戒指中传来，霎那间，石岩生出一种和戒指血脉相连的感觉，仿佛这戒指已经成了他身体的一部分，体内微弱之极的精元，突然不受控制，猛地朝着那暗红色的戒指冲去，精元狂涌向皮层，却被无名指上的皮肉挡住，难以进入戒指中。

心中一惊，石岩立即觉得这戒指诡异，急忙去褪戒指，却发现那戒指已牢牢扣在他无名指上，像是生根发芽了，不论他如何使力，都难以将这一枚古怪的戒指褪下。

精元冲不破皮肉的阻碍，一会儿功夫又恢复了正常，重新在小腹处沉没。那戒指上的红光闪烁了一会儿，也不再崭亮，戒指上的温热感也消失不见了。

晃动了一会儿手指，发现这一枚戒指并没有异常之后，他也就不在意了，打量着周围的场景，石岩认真思考。

很快的，石岩得出了一个匪夷所思的结论——血池内的血水已全部涌入他身体中了！

血池有十平方米，虽然不大，但其中蕴藏的血水却至少有几吨重，就是一头大象，也不可能一次性喝光几顿血水啊！

石岩脸色有些难看，他下意识的环顾周身，想要看看自己这一具身体有什么变化，会不会变得臃肿不堪。

他不但没有变得臃肿，相反，他身体竟然比之前还要消瘦，简直是皮包骨头，那一身原先还算是合身的衣服，一下子大了好几号，手上腿上全身上下，都没有几两肉，宛如一具骷髅披了层人皮。

与其叫消瘦，不如叫干瘪的木乃伊了。

石岩脸色更加难看了，他没想到这血池不但没有将他送回熟悉的世界，竟然还带给了他如此诡异的变化。

饥饿的讯号，从他肚子中传来，石岩突然觉得食欲无限，可以吃掉一头大象。

石洞中遍地尸骨，根本没有什么可吃的，他看了看那干枯的血池，突然意识到自己怕是再也回不去了。

石岩想要找一把武器出去，他记得那些护卫自相残杀的时候，刀光剑影，金铁交击声不绝于耳，可他在石洞内转了一圈后，却发现所有的武器都在短短时间内被腐蚀了，没一个能用的。

无奈下，石岩只能空手从进入的通道离开。

空气潮湿，热浪滚滚，潺潺的水流声从远处传来，一株株古树拔地而起，怕是有几十米高，茂密的灌木如巨伞一样将阳光遮住，只有少许日光顽强的投射在湿地上。

这是幽暗森林，石岩一出来，马上从身体原主人的记忆中，明白了自己的位置。

这个森林占地辽阔，因为林中的树木过于茂密，连日光都很难投射进来，使得森林中即便是在白昼也是阴暗潮湿，所以才被称为幽暗森林。

幽暗森林在商盟、烈火帝国、神佑帝国中央，商盟在森林北边，神佑帝国在南边，幽暗森林直接将商盟和神佑帝国隔了开来，烈火帝国则是在西边，各国商队想要去别国做买卖，幽暗森林乃是必经之路。

幽暗森林中常有妖兽出没，六七级的妖兽也不少见，不过三个国家的商队、佣兵、武者在幽暗森林走的多了，都知道厉害的妖兽一般都只是在特定的区域活动，只有低等级的妖兽才会居无定所。

一般来说，商队只要按照特定的路线在幽暗森林中活动，不要到那些高等级妖兽横行的区域闯荡，大多不会出什么事，只有专门盯着高等级妖兽而来的佣兵和武者，才容易在幽暗森林和高等级妖兽碰面，进而死伤惨重。

高风险伴着高利益，佣兵冒险者如果能够在幽暗森林中，斩杀了六七级的妖兽，都会立即获得巨额晶币，六级的妖兽体内已经有了妖晶，妖晶不论是对武者还是炼药师、炼器师，都有很大的帮助，价值连城。

除了妖晶之外，妖兽身上的毛皮，獠牙利齿，筋骨，甚至毒液，都价值不菲，高等级的妖兽可谓浑身是宝。

也是因为如此，常常有不怕死的武者和佣兵来幽暗森林冒险，目的就是为了高等级的妖兽，不过得到好处的永远都是少数人，很多人都低估了妖兽的智慧和强大，不但没能如愿以偿，反而成了妖兽的美味。

从石洞内出来，石岩观察了一会儿周围的环境，听到嘈杂的声响从远处水流的方向传入耳朵，那些话题全部都是以女人为主，时不时夹杂几句“嘿嘿”淫笑声。

就在石岩犹豫着要不要立即过去看看的时候，突然，他发现在前方不远处的一片灌木丛中有轻微的“沙沙”声，像是什么人在拨弄着灌木丛叶子。

只见在那一片灌木丛中，一道身姿曼妙的女人，款款解下了素白的腰带，背对着她蹲下来，露出水蜜桃形状的雪白屁股，一边挥舞着芊芊玉手在身后驱赶惹人厌的蚊虫，一遍欢快地小解……

女人显然不知身后有人，在“哗哗”的水流声中还哼起不知名的小曲，心情很是愉悦。

石岩先是一呆，旋即反应过来，毫不客气地在她那耀眼的雪白处巡视着，暗赞这女人光是屁股便如此迷人，不知道真容如何。

女人突然反手一拍，打在自己光滑嫩白的左臀上，将一只大胆的蚊虫归西，她那臀肉先是销魂的往内猛地一缩，在她迅速抽手之后又荡漾出醉人的波动，可见弹性极佳，勾的石岩心中也是一荡。

在石岩恋恋不舍的目光下，女人小解结束，悉悉索索的将腰带系好，自言自语地嘀咕：“该死的蚊子……”

全无征兆的情况下，女人突然转身，两手青弧电光骤现，将身后聚集的蚊虫裹住，在“噼啪”的声响中所有蚊虫都被绞杀。

随着她的转身，女人的真容被彻底显现出来，她有一张皓月般的精致面容，二十岁上下，身高一米六八左右，生的丰神冶丽，腰肢纤细，胸部饱满，身姿玲珑，淡紫色底衫上裹着银灰色软甲，那紧贴娇躯的软甲显然遮不住她那动人心魄的曲线，如传说中的山野美狐。

石岩目光如炬，火辣辣的落到她身上，暗赞此女比得上他那世界上的倾国女星了。

在石岩贪婪的目光在她美妙的身姿上游荡不停的时候，那美女突生警觉，相隔数片巨大的芭蕉叶，她竟然都能准确地找上石岩的眼睛。

content_en:
Shi Yan stood in the blood pool. The water only reached his waist, but the blood in the blood pool seemed to be alive all of a sudden. It condensed like vines and wound up his body. In just a few seconds, his whole body was covered with blood, and his whole body was wrapped tightly.

The blood in the blood pool seemed to have turned into scarlet blood snakes, which continued to wrap around him, wrapping him into a huge blood cocoon.

Severe pain spread all over his body, and Shi Yan's brain felt as if it had been cut with a reamer, and he was in so much pain that he couldn't bear to die.

It was as if billions of tiny insects were burrowing into his body through the pores all over his body, squirming in his limbs, bones, and internal organs, as if gnawing at the flesh and blood of his body, causing pain and torture like being cut into pieces by a thousand knives.

Shi Yan couldn't see and wanted to howl, but he couldn't make any sound and couldn't move his body.

Traces of strange fluids flowed slowly along his veins, like trickles. Wherever those fluids passed, the tendons in his body that had never been exposed to foreign power seemed to be torn apart. Those fluids flowed rapidly, divided into countless strands, and crazily injected into the seven hundred and twenty acupuncture points in his body.

Shi Yan felt that the seven hundred and twenty acupuncture points in his body seemed to have been suddenly expanded countless times. One moment it was extremely hot, and the next moment it became bone-chilling, and it was indescribably uncomfortable.

The tingling pain in his mind became more and more severe. In a daze, Shi Yan seemed to see his acupuncture points undergoing strange changes under the injection of those strange substances. Every acupuncture point in his body seemed to have turned into a small cyclone, spinning crazily.

A trace of bright red semen was injected into those cyclones, and seemed to be quickly digested and became part of the cyclone. After obtaining those semen, the cyclone became larger and larger. After the cyclone became larger, the speed of digesting those semen gradually accelerated.

I don't know if it was because the pain was beyond his ability to bear. In his hazy state, Shi Yan felt as if his body had become a huge container. The strange fluids pouring into his body from the pores all over his body seemed to be changing his body in a way that he could not understand.

To be exact, they are changing the 720 acupuncture points in his body!

When this idea emerged in his mind, the next moment, an unbearable sting suddenly burst out in his mind. All Shi Yan's consciousness disappeared and he fainted in an instant.

I don't know how long it took, but Shi Yan woke up again.

He immediately found that the pain in his mind and body was no longer there, and there were no longer those strange fluids flowing in his body. He felt and understood it seriously. Except for the faint pain in the acupuncture points all over his body, everything in his body seemed to be back to normal.

Suddenly, he felt a warm air flow, like a small snake swimming in the veins in his body. After a short week, he felt comfortable all over, and his hands and feet seemed to have a little more strength.

Shi Yan's heart skipped a beat, and he immediately realized that the blood pool had finally brought him some benefit. The veins in his body were swimming like little snakes. It was obviously an essence that only warriors could possess!

Through the memory of another Shi Yan, he knew that Jingyuan was the source of power for warriors in this world and the basis for warriors to release powerful martial arts.

According to the strength of the essence in the body and the level of the realm, warriors are strictly divided into ten levels, which are acquired, innate, human, hundred calamities, status, nirvana, heaven, psychic, true god, and god king. Each level is divided into three levels of heaven.

Warriors are the strongest in this world. The biggest basis for judging the difference between warriors and ordinary people is to see whether there is essence in a person's body. As long as a person has a little essence in his body, no matter how much, he can be called a warrior.

Many people will not be able to possess Jingyuan throughout their lives. As long as a person possesses Jingyuan, he can make it stronger through hard training. Therefore, as long as a warrior possesses Jingyuan, there will always be a place in this world.

Feeling the slow flow of the weak essence in his body, Shi Yan suddenly felt a little more at ease. He knew that even if he couldn't go back now, he wouldn't starve to death in this world.

Relieved, Shi Yan immediately noticed that the blood cocoon covering his body was still there, and still wrapped him tightly.

The blood cocoon burst into a big hole, and Shi Yan suddenly jumped out and looked around. He found that he was still in the strange cave, surrounded by bones.

However, the blood in the blood pool dried up, with not a drop left!

In the dried-up blood pool, only dozens of broken bones remained, and the scarlet-thick blood that filled the pool disappeared without a trace.

A huge blood cocoon stood tall in the center of the blood pool. The blood cocoon was as thin as a cicada's wing and was still shining brightly. However, he just glanced at it, and a small flame ignited from the bottom of the blood cocoon. The flame grew from small to large, and even ignited the bones in the blood pool. In just a moment, all the blood cocoons and bones in the blood pool were burned clean.

In the dry blood pool, red light shone, and an ancient ring with complicated blood patterns fell quietly into the blood pool.

After staring at the strange ring for a few times, Shi Yan vaguely felt that the ring had something to do with the blood pool. After hesitating for a moment, Shi Yan stepped forward to pick up the ring and put it on the ring finger of his left hand.

A warm feeling came from the ring. In an instant, Shi Yan had a feeling of blood connection with the ring, as if the ring had become a part of his body. The extremely weak essence in his body suddenly lost control and rushed towards the dark red ring. The essence rushed towards the cortex, but was blocked by the flesh on the ring finger, making it difficult to enter the ring.

Shocked, Shi Yan immediately felt that the ring was strange and hurriedly took it off, only to find that the ring was firmly attached to his ring finger, as if it had taken root. No matter how hard he tried, he could not take off the strange ring.

The essence could not break through the barrier of flesh and blood, and after a while the energy returned to normal and sank again in the lower abdomen.The red light on the ring flickered for a while, but was no longer bright, and the warmth on the ring also disappeared.

After waggling his fingers for a while and finding that there was nothing abnormal about the ring, he stopped caring. Looking at the surrounding scene, Shi Yan thought seriously.

Soon, Shi Yan came to an incredible conclusion - all the blood in the blood pool had poured into his body!

The blood pool is ten square meters. Although it is not large, the blood contained in it weighs at least several tons. Even an elephant cannot drink up several meals of blood in one go!

Shi Yan's face looked a little ugly. He subconsciously looked around, trying to see if there were any changes in his body, whether it would become bloated.

Not only did he not become bloated, on the contrary, his body was even thinner than before. He was almost skinny and bones. The clothes that used to fit him were suddenly several sizes too big. There was not much flesh on his hands, legs, and body, just like a skeleton covered with a layer of human skin.

Instead of calling it emaciated, it would be better to call it a shriveled mummy.

Shi Yan's face became even uglier. He didn't expect that this blood pool not only failed to send him back to the familiar world, but also brought about such strange changes in him.

The signal of hunger came from his stomach, and Shi Yan suddenly felt that his appetite was unlimited and he could eat an elephant.

There were corpses everywhere in the cave, and there was nothing to eat. He looked at the pool of dried blood and suddenly realized that he was afraid he would never go back.

Shi Yan wanted to find a weapon to get out. He remembered that when the guards were fighting each other, the sound of swords and swords and the clash of gold and iron could be heard endlessly. However, after he walked around the cave, he found that all the weapons had been corroded in a short period of time, and none of them were usable.

In desperation, Shi Yan could only leave the passage empty-handed.

The air is humid, the heat wave is rolling, and the sound of gurgling water comes from a distance. Ancient trees rise from the ground, perhaps tens of meters high. The dense shrubs block the sun like giant umbrellas, leaving only a little sunlight shining on the wetland.

This is a dark forest. As soon as Shi Yan came out, he immediately understood his location from the memory of the original owner of the body.

This forest occupies a vast area. Because the trees in the forest are too dense, it is difficult for sunlight to enter, making the forest dark and humid even during the day, so it is called the dark forest.

The Dark Forest is in the center of the Merchant Alliance, the Agni Fire Empire, and the Divine Bless Empire. The Merchant Alliance is to the north of the forest, and the Divine Bless Empire is to the south. The Dark Forest directly separates the Merchant Alliance from the Divine Bless Empire, while the Agni Fire Empire is to the west. If caravans from various countries want to do business in other countries, the Dark Forest is the only way to go.

Monsters often appear in the dark forest, and monsters at level six or seven are not uncommon. However, caravans, mercenaries, and warriors from the three countries have been in the dark forest a lot, and they all know that powerful monsters usually only move in specific areas, and only low-level monsters live in no fixed places.

Generally speaking, as long as caravans follow specific routes in the dark forest and do not wander into areas where high-level monsters are rampant, most of them will not get into trouble. Only mercenaries and warriors who come specifically to keep an eye on high-level monsters are likely to encounter high-level monsters in the dark forest, resulting in heavy casualties.

High risks come with high benefits. If a mercenary adventurer can kill a sixth- or seventh-level monster in the dark forest, he will immediately receive a huge amount of crystal coins. The sixth-level monster already has demon crystals in his body. The demon crystal is of great help to warriors, alchemists, and weapon refiners, and is extremely valuable.

In addition to the demon crystals, the fur, fangs, teeth, muscles, and even venom of the demon beasts are all valuable. High-level demon beasts are full of treasures.

It is also because of this that warriors and mercenaries who are not afraid of death often come to the dark forest to take risks for the sake of high-level monsters. However, only a few people get the benefits. Many people underestimate the wisdom and power of monsters. Not only do they fail to get what they want, but they become the delicacies of monsters.
